entry.title: Meta expands Instagram’s AI age-guessing tech globally
entry.summary: Meta says it will use its AI technology to look for clues about people it suspects to be teenagers — even if they use an adult birthday.

entry.title: Medium’s new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process
entry.summary: Medium's new writing app embraces AI-assisted writing, despite growing controversy over the technology's role in publishing.

entry.title: Anthropic joins AI’s natural gas frenzy, buys $3.4B worth of turbines
entry.summary: Anthropic bought billions of dollars' worth of natural gas turbines in a deal that could give it buyer's remorse.

entry.title: Uber launches parking service following SpotHero acquisition, with an eye on robotaxis
entry.summary: Uber Parking is the latest example of the company offering products beyond its core ride-hailing service.

entry.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
entry.summary: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember is significantly cheaper than frontier competitors like Haiku and Luna.

entry.title: Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy puts Nvidia’s China ambitions under scrutiny
entry.summary: Jensen Huang’s alleged affair with a suspected Chinese spy threatens to complicate Nvidia’s lobbying efforts to loosen U.S. chip export restrictions and maintain access to China’s lucrative AI market.

entry.title: France blames Iran for mass-hacks targeting freezers in grocery stores and blood banks
entry.summary: France's foreign minister blamed Iran for launching at least two waves of cyberattacks targeting industrial refrigerated and freezer units across France and wider Europe.

entry.title: AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
entry.summary: Nominal, a startup that offers an AI platform for hardware engineering and claims Anduril as a major customer, has raised another big round of financing that triples its valuation.

entry.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
entry.summary: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.

entry.title: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
entry.summary: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027 after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.

entry.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
entry.summary: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

entry.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
entry.summary: Geothermal company Fervo is targeting natural gas as it brings down geothermal drilling costs at its 8.4 GW resource in Utah.

entry.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
entry.summary: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

entry.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
entry.summary: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.

entry.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
entry.summary: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.

entry.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
entry.summary: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

entry.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
entry.summary: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

entry.title: Jensen Huang’s alleged honeypot scandal has inspired some top-notch memes
entry.summary: The internet is having a field day with Nvidia's Jensen Huang's alleged honeypot scandal.

entry.title: California’s proposed ‘billionaire tax’ fails to pass
entry.summary: California voters rejected Proposition 40, the one-time 5% tax on billionaires, the AP reported Monday. Tech leaders outspent backers roughly 10 to 1 to defeat it, and the founders and economists TechCrunch interviewed before the vote were split on whether it would have driven out wealthy residents or just trimmed their fortunes.

entry.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
entry.summary: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.
